text: Fixed broken roxygen2 comment check_loaded_namespaces() caused first sentence @details help section silently dropped. page previously opened mid-sentence “(packages loaded attached)…”; now correctly reads “checker inspects list loaded namespaces (packages loaded attached)…”. Fixed latent bug internal .action() helper passing status object unexpected class left variable is_ok undefined, causing uninformative object 'is_ok' found error. function now uses else branching raises explicit “unexpected status class” error unrecognized inputs. Fixed sessioncheck() validate checks argument. Previously, unrecognized check names (e.g. typo) silently ignored; now produce error listing valid check names. Fixed misleading mock sessioncheck() test suite: mock .get_locale_status() returning bare string instead sessioncheck_status object, making associated assertion meaningless. mock now returns properly-constructed status object.

title: sessioncheck 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. package provides tools checking whether R session clean state. main user-facing functions : check_globalenv_objects() — flags unexpected objects .GlobalEnv. check_attached_packages() — flags non-base packages search path. check_loaded_namespaces() — flags non-base loaded namespaces. check_attached_environments() — flags non-package attachments search path. check_sessiontime() — flags sessions running longer threshold (default 300 seconds). check_required_options() — flags R options absent unexpected values. check_required_locale() — flags locale categories unexpected values. check_required_sysenv() — flags system environment variables absent unexpected values. sessioncheck() — top-level orchestrator runs multiple checks single call. check functions accept action argument ("warn", "error", "message", "none") return invisible sessioncheck_status object. Default behavior allowlists can configured project-wide via options(sessioncheck = list(...)).
